name: Volume / quantity-tiered discount (PriceAdjustmentTier step-down)
what_it_tests: A qualifying-quantity non-contracted line receives a per-unit price that steps down by quantity band (1-100, 101-250, 251+) via PriceAdjustmentSchedule/Tier
proc_mechanism: Volume Discount Entries; Volume Discounts ((IsContracted IsNull OR =false) AND ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction'); PriceAdjustmentSchedule/PriceAdjustmentTier keyed on Qty band
expected_behavior: Tier matching ordered qty applies (e.g. Qty=300 uses 251+ band, lower per-unit than 1-100 band)
test_setup: Tripwire nodes perpetual, Qty=300, tiers 1-100=220k/node, 101-250 lower; IsContracted=false, New quote

run3_result.defectStep: V21 step 'Volume Discount Entries' (VolumeDiscountEntries) + gate 'Volume Discounts' (VolumeDiscounts). VolumePASIdConstant='' makes the BKM lookup a no-op. This is NOT a defect — it is the intended design; Fortra uses the attribute-tier engine (Attribute_Tier_Pricing_Storage__c + Standard Attribute Based Adjustment schedule) for all quantity/volume tiers, not the native PriceAdjustmentSchedule/PriceAdjustmentTier path.
